transcripts.transcript: The teaching adviser supports recording large lectures because students can return to difficult explanations. However, she warns that recordings should not become a reason to remove opportunities for discussion. In her view, access to a video is useful only when students also have a way to ask questions and practise applying the ideas.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别专家意见中的支持与条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The transport planner expects demand for evening buses to grow if more classes finish late. But she says the available figures are too limited to justify doubling the service immediately. She recommends collecting another term of data and adjusting the timetable gradually, rather than treating the forecast as a guaranteed outcome.
transcripts.target_signal: 区别专家预测与确定事实
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Before buying more storage space, the records specialist recommends checking which files are duplicated and which must be retained. She points out that extra capacity will not solve confusion about ownership or retention periods. Once those rules are clear, the organisation can estimate how much additional storage it actually needs.
transcripts.target_signal: 从专家建议中提取行动顺序
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The statistical adviser says the difference between the two averages is worth examining, but it should not be interpreted on its own. The groups vary in size, and individual results overlap substantially. She recommends looking at the spread of the data before claiming that every member of one group performs better than every member of the other.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别专家明确反对的过度推断
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The writing adviser finds automatic checks useful for spotting repeated words and some spelling errors. Yet she argues that a tool may not understand what a student intends to say or whether an example supports the argument. She therefore recommends using the checks as a first step, followed by careful reading and discussion.
transcripts.target_signal: 理解专家对工具能力的边界判断
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The accessibility consultant has recommended moving the main reception desk closer to the step-free entrance. The university has not yet approved the change, because electrical work would also be needed. The consultant will discuss a temporary desk with staff next week so that visitors can receive help while the permanent proposal is assessed.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分专家建议与已实施政策
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: An urban planner argues that adding bus routes will have limited value if passengers cannot rely on the timetable. She recommends improving service reliability alongside network coverage, rather than treating the number of routes as the only measure of success.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析专家看法（仅六级）的含义与适用条件

transcripts.transcript: An education researcher warns that time spent on a learning app is not enough to show whether students have understood the material. She suggests checking what students can explain or apply after using it.

transcripts.transcript: A transport engineer says that a new cycle lane should connect useful destinations, not simply add distance to the network. A short route linking homes to a station may serve residents better than a longer route that ends far from everyday services.

transcripts.transcript: A librarian argues that opening a digital collection does not automatically make it accessible. Visitors still need clear descriptions and a reliable search system. Without these, a large archive may remain difficult to use even when every file is online.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析专家看法（仅六级）的含义与适用条件

transcripts.transcript: A researcher studying online information cautions that a confident presentation can make a weak claim seem convincing. She advises readers to check the evidence and its source, rather than judging a statement only by how certain the speaker sounds.

transcripts.transcript: A workplace consultant recommends testing a new schedule with one team before applying it across the organisation. The trial should collect both staff feedback and information about service quality, since an arrangement that suits employees may still create problems for customers.
